title: Complete coherent control of spin qubits in self-assembled InAs quantum dots under oblique magnetic fields
summary: We demonstrate complete coherent control of a single spin qubit confined in a self-assembled InAs negatively charged quantum dot subjected to an Oblique magnetic field, and directly compare this regime with the conventional Voigt geometry. In the Oblique-field configuration, the groundstate spin eigenstates are found to be unequal superpositions of the bare electron spin, with their composition tunable via the orientation of the applied field.
